name: Boogiemon
main_effect: [On Play] Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. Add 1 card with the [Fallen Angel] or [Demon Lord] trait and 1 purple Option card among them to the hand. Return the rest to the bottom of the deck. If you added cards, trash 1 card in your hand.
source_effect: [All Turns] While your opponent has 6 or fewer cards in their hand, this Digimon gets +1000 DP.
